title: pool()/unlockCallback single-sided sUSDS LP-add relies solely on off-chain keeper minBPT with no on-chain price reference (MEV sandwich)
rootCauseClass: missing on-chain slippage reference / off-chain-trusted bound (MEV LP-add sandwich)
fingerprintBasis: src/V2/dispatchers/BalancerPoolerV2.sol:pool:missing on-chain slippage reference / off-chain-trusted bound (MEV LP-add sandwich)
distinctFrom: L-03 (fingerprint e29ae08e…) — same contract+function name 'pool' but a DIFFERENT rootCauseClass (old donation sUSDS->waUSDC AMM swap, removed by story-034). DD-04 is the SEPARATE single-sided AddLiquidityKind.UNBALANCED pooling leg. Fingerprint 342075df… differs from L-03 e29ae08e…, so this is origin=new, NOT a regression/reopen of the fixed L-03.
description: pool() (lines 269-275) and its unlockCallback (lines 278-314) perform a single-sided AddLiquidityKind.UNBALANCED join into the Balancer V3 sUSDS/phUSD pool whose only slippage protection is an off-chain keeper-supplied minBPT floor; there is no on-chain price reference (e.g. getIdealBPT()/queryAddLiquidityUnbalanced) to tighten that floor at call time. This is the borderline Low/Medium of the run, held at Low.
impact: Bounded protocol-treasury value leak: BPT minted to the dispatcher (protocol treasury) on the single-sided join can be less than fair if the sUSDS/phUSD pool is skewed around the join. Loss falls on the protocol treasury, NOT on minters/users, and is bounded by (idealBPT - minBPT), where minBPT is the keeper-supplied floor. The H-02 accumulate-then-dump design enlarges the single join and thus the extractable imbalance.
attackPath: Authorized keeper broadcasts pool(minBPT) to the public mempool (pool() is onlyAuthorizedPooler whenNotPaused nonReentrant; an external attacker cannot initiate it).
Attacker observes the pending tx and sandwiches it: skews the Balancer V3 sUSDS/phUSD pool price immediately before the single-sided join.

The join executes at the skewed price; the contract receives bptAmountOut >= minBPT but below the unskewed-fair amount because there is no on-chain price reference to tighten the floor beyond the off-chain minBPT.
Attacker reverses the skew after the join, capturing up to (idealBPT - minBPT) in value extracted from treasury BPT.
recommendation: Cheap on-chain hardening: derive/clamp minBPT against the on-chain getIdealBPT()/queryAddLiquidityUnbalanced quote at call time, and/or broadcast pool() via a private relay (Flashbots). With a tight on-chain-derived minBPT or a private relay, extractable value approaches zero.
borderlineResolution: Held at Low: existing off-chain slippage floor (minBPT default is NOT zero) + permissioned (non-attacker-initiated) trigger + protocol-controllable bounded magnitude + treasury-only (no user) exposure + L-03 precedent keep it sub-Medium. Recommend on-chain minBPT derivation/clamp as remediation.
